firm_data.firm_description: Kaplan Martin LLP is a civil and commercial litigation, investigations, and strategic advisory law firm. We combine decades of collective experience and expertise to litigate the most challenging cases for individuals, corporations, and other for-profit and not-for-profit entities on both sides of the “v.”
notable_facts: Our lawyers have an unparalleled track record of successfully litigating some of the most high-profile and consequential issues of the last 30 years, including landmark legislative and Supreme Court victories for marriage equality and many dozens of successful jury trials, arbitrations, and out-of-court settlements for a diverse array of clients.
Kaplan Martin advises corporate boards, C-Suite executives, and senior leaders in navigating their most sensitive and complicated legal issues.
